Fields.Name: Legs
Fields.Description: The character's legs: their bones, axes and limits.

Fields.Name: Raycast Distance Up
Fields.Description: How far above the foot the ground raycast starts.

Fields.Name: Raycast Distance Down
Fields.Description: How far below the foot the ground raycast reaches.

Fields.Name: Original Ground Height
Fields.Description: The ground's height in the animations, in model space.

Fields.Name: Vertical Offset
Fields.Description: An offset added to the ground height found.

Fields.Name: Collision Filter Info
Fields.Description: The collision filter of the ground raycasts.

Fields.Name: Forward Align Fraction
Fields.Description: How much the character tilts forward / back to match the ground (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: Sideways Align Fraction
Fields.Description: How much the character tilts sideways to match the ground (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: Sideways Sample Width
Fields.Description: How far apart the sideways ground samples are.

Fields.Name: Lock Feet When Planted
Fields.Description: Whether planted feet are locked in place, so they don't slide.

Fields.Name: Use Character Up Vector
Fields.Description: Whether the raycasts go along the character's up, not the world's.

Fields.Name: Is Quadruped Narrow
Fields.Description: Whether the character is a narrow quadruped (aligned on its front and back legs only).

Fields.Name: Keep Source Foot End Above Ground
Fields.Description: Whether the animation's foot end is kept above the ground.
